about_the_game:
Experience Version Description

In the experience version, the first map is unlocked: Old Street.

In the experience version, the first character is unlocked: Machine Gunner - Patterson.

Buildings unlocked in the experience version include: Gym, Library, Bar, Dormitory. (Buildings cannot be upgraded in the experience version)

The experience version currently includes 74 cards and 66 relics.

Zombie Epoch: Deck Apocalypse is a post-apocalyptic survival game that blends dungeon exploration with card-based strategy. As a survivor, you must venture into perilous ruins, scavenge scarce resources, build a powerful deck, and enhance your abilities to withstand relentless zombie hordes.

Every expedition is a battle for survival—you must carefully choose your path, manage resources wisely, and craft your own playstyle from randomly obtained items and cards while facing increasingly formidable enemies!

As you grow stronger, you'll unlock more challenging areas, rare items, and powerful cards.

Your ultimate goal is not just survival, but the restoration of humanity—rekindling the flames of civilization!

Each map is randomly generated, with different items, cards, and zombies appearing in every run. You'll need to plan your movement carefully, explore dungeons, and collect vital supplies.

Choose from a variety of rewards and build a unique playstyle to counter the ever-growing zombie threat!

Loot is divided into cards and items—cards can be played directly in battle, while items provide passive effects. Most cards and items can stack, creating powerful synergies!

After each dungeon run, you can unlock or upgrade buildings at your camp, permanently enhancing your character’s abilities and preparing for greater challenges ahead.

The game features a variety of characters, each with unique traits. As you progress, you'll unlock new characters, each offering a distinct gameplay experience!

  • Deep Strategic Cardplay
    Construct your own deck and item combinations to adapt to different combat scenarios.

  • Roguelike Dungeon Exploration
    Designed for high replayability—each run is a fresh experience, full of surprises and tough choices.

  • Rebuild Humanity
    Gather resources, rebuild your base, and unlock new technologies to reclaim the world.

  • A Note from the Developer

    I’m an indie game developer, and this game is entirely created by me. If you like it, follow me and join my Discord!
